SELECT cls, CAST(fished_date_doy/10 AS INT)*10 AS doy_bucket,
       SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, COUNT(*) AS n,
       SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season=6 AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 60 AND 91
  AND cls IN ('day_1_5','three_quarter','hd_am','hd_pm','overnight')
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2
